IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
wavy hair walks down a wide stone
staircase. She wears a fitted burgundy
velvet jacket with gold beaded trim over
a deep wine silk gown with a flowing
train. A small pendant rests at her throat.
Her expression is calm and serious.
Cool, moody light with soft haze. Palette
of burgundy, slate gray, and antique
gold. Dramatic and gothic, in the style of
a cinematic fantasy film still.
